_about: Hand-authored config. OUR design decisions, not values measured from the original.
CLAUDE.md rule 1: gameplay numbers live here, never in a .gd file.
JSON has no comments, so notes use _-prefixed keys. DataLoader ignores them.
NOT IN THIS FILE, deliberately: every portal value (momentum_mode, exit_offset_px,
reentry_lockout_s, transit_time_s, camera_lerp_s, sfx_lead_s, ...). Those belong in
portals.json and MILESTONE_1.md section 3 requires each to be MEASURED by
frame-stepping recorded footage of the original. That footage does not exist yet
(blocker 7.6). A plausible guess is worse than a blank, because the feel target is
exactly what fails silently. Do not create portals.json from estimates.

_note: Ours, provisional. Touch-first per CLAUDE.md rule 4. These are pointer-gesture
thresholds, not portal-feel values, so authoring them now is safe - but they
should still be sanity-checked on a real device before the milestone closes.
MEASURED, not invented (MILESTONE_1 7.3, resolved 2026-08-04). The original keeps
two integers - lastWorldAllowed / lastLevelAllowed - a single high-water mark.
Levels are NOT gated on stars or medals: a skip-level button exists and medals are
cosmetic. The original's other gate is free-vs-paid purchase, deliberately not
modelled here - it is a store concern and out of scope for this milestone.
MILESTONE_1 section 4: 'Level failure and retry must be instant - no load screen
between retries.' retry_transition_s MUST stay 0. LevelManager caches the
PackedScene so a retry is an instantiate, never a disk load. If a transition is
ever wanted, put it on level ADVANCE, never on retry.
